mapper.insert: insert into coach (coach_no, coach_name, coach_sex, coach_age, coach_tel, good_at, coach_status, coach_pwd, create_time) values (#{coachNo}, #{coachName}, #{coachSex}, #{coachAge}, #{coachTel}, #{goodAt}, #{coachStatus}, #{coachPwd}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update coach set coach_no = #{coachNo}, coach_name = #{coachName}, coach_sex = #{coachSex}, coach_age = #{coachAge}, coach_tel = #{coachTel}, good_at = #{goodAt}, coach_status = #{coachStatus}, coach_pwd = #{coachPwd} where coach_id = #{coachId}
